fusions.name: Startling Report
fusions.desc: A sudden shot that deals 14 damage and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Scatter Load
fusions.desc: Looses a wide spread of shot that deals 7 damage to everything caught in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Blunted] for 5 seconds. You hold 4 charges and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Steady Aim
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Fire
fusions.desc: If 8 seconds pass without a critical hit, your next strike has 40% more critical chance. Once every 8 seconds.
